notes.title: 1.0.3 The Game is Clearer Now
notes.content:
Changes:
- The teachers in the lower room of the school now have additional dialogue instructing the player on how to get to class and how to advance the story.

- Arrow signs have been added in the hallway to give better instruction on where to go in the upper room of the school. If you're still stuck by that point, press enter on the ends of the hallways.

- Mouse Cursor no longer appears on screen.

- Adjusted tutorial text to not remain in the borders  in fullscreen 
- Changed text during the end sequence to be more clear and not hint that the player should quit the game (My Bad)
